synopsis: かいせつ 妹の縁談相手の男は、見合いに同席した姉に惹かれ…。数々の傑作を生み出し黄金期となる大映での溝口の第一作。名キャメラマン・宮川とも初めて組み、美しい姉妹と一人の男の揺れ動く三角関係を繊細で夢幻的な映像美で描く。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Shinnosuke is introduced to Shizu as a prospective marriage partner, but he falls in love with her widowed sister Oyu. Convention forbids Oyu to marry because she has to raise her son as the head of her husband's family. Oyu convinces Shinnosuke and Shizu to marry so that she can remain close to Shinnosuke.
synopsis_en: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.

synopsis: かいせつ 最愛の妃を亡くした唐の玄宗皇帝が、一人の娘を見初めて…。香港との共同制作となった溝口初のカラー作品は、傾国の美女・楊貴妃の愛と悲運を描いた宮廷絵巻。エキゾチックな衣装と美術を際立たせる抑えた色調が目をひく。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In 8th-century China, the Emperor grieves the death of his wife. The Yang family wants to provide the Emperor with a consort so that they may consolidate their court influence. General An Lushan finds a distant relative working in their kitchen, whom they groom to present to the Emperor. The Emperor falls in love and she becomes the Princess Yang Kwei-fei. The Yangs are then appointed important ministers, though An Lushan is not given the court position he covets.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.

synopsis: かいせつ 旧華族の一人娘の雪は、婿養子の夫の放蕩と横暴に苦しめられ…。戦前から在籍した松竹を離れた溝口が新東宝で撮った官能のメロドラマ。雪夫人を演じた木暮の目も眩む濃密なエロスが、溝口独特の耽美的な世界へと誘い込む。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman takes up her new job as the servant of a noblewoman and soon discovers that underneath her facade of luxury lies great unhappiness.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.

When the fuel truck doesn't arrive on time, the salesman passes the time chatting with a waitress. A vicious bank robber shows up, taking the salesman and waitress hostage. However, because there's no gasoline, the bank robber can't leave the diner either. Unaware of the situation, a steady stream of quirky customers arrives at the diner: an elderly couple, an Indian chief, a hapless sheriff, and a couple aspiring to be criminals. Jim Cummings of "The Thunder Road" plays the salesman, Jocelin Donahue of "The House of the Devil" plays the waitress, and Richard Brake of "Barbarian" plays the bank robber. The film won the Best Picture award in the ORBITA section at the 2023 Sitges International Film Festival, which selects the best thrillers, suspense, and action films, earning high praise.

synopsis: 18世紀初頭、作曲家ヴィヴァルディがベネチアのピエタ院にバイオリン教師として赴任した実話を題材に、彼の指導のもと才能を開花させていく孤独な少女の成長と、己の才能が評価されることを渇望するヴィヴァルディの内なる野望を描いたドラマ。 1716年、ベネチアのピエタ院。母の姿も愛情も知らないまま育ったチェチリアは、毎晩こっそりベッドから抜け出しては宛名のない母への手紙をつづっていた。ピエタ院から出て外の世界で暮らすには、母が迎えに来るか、貴族と結婚するしかない。そんな中、ピエタ院にバイオリン教師として赴任したアントニオ・ヴィヴァルディは、チェチリアの卓越したバイオリン技術を見いだし、第一バイオリンのリーダーに任命する。チェチリアはヴィヴァルディのもとで厳しい練習に耐えながらバイオリンの腕を磨き、いつしか2人は心を通わせるようになる。しかし、ピエタ院がチェチリアの結婚相手に定めた将校が戦争から戻り、やがて事件が起こる。 イタリアのテレビドラマ「アート・オブ・ジョイ」で注目されたテクラ・インソリアがチェチリア、「眠れる美女」のミケーレ・リオンディーノがヴィヴァルディを演じた。監督・脚本を手がけたのはイタリアを代表するオペラ演出家で、ミラノ・コルティナ冬季オリンピックの開・閉会式でクリエイティブディレクターを務めたダミアーノ・ミキエレット。
tmdb_overview_jp: 1716 年、ヴェネツィアのピエタ院。赤ちゃんポストに置き去りにされたチェチリア（テクラ・インソリア）は、母の姿も愛情も知らずにこの院で育ち、毎晩こっそりベッドから抜け出してはろうそくの灯りで、宛名のない母への手紙を綴っていた。院から出て外の世界で暮らすには、母親が迎えに来るか、貴族に見いだされ結婚するかしかなかった。そんな中、ピエタ院にアントニオ・ヴィヴァルディ（ミケーレ・リオンディーノ）がヴァイオリン教師として赴任すると、卓越したヴァイオリンの技術を持つチェチリアを見出し、第一ヴァイオリンのリーダーに任命する。ヴィヴァルディからの厳しい練習に耐え、ヴァイオリンの腕があがっていくチェチリア。いつしか二人は心を通わせるようになる。そんな折、ピエタ院が決めたチェチリアの結婚相手である将校がトルコとの戦争から戻り、結婚が迫ったある日、事件が起こる……。
tmdb_overview_en: In 18th-century Venice, 20-year-old violin virtuoso Cecilia lives at the Pièta orphanage, where, despite her talent, she remains confined, knowing that marriage is the only way out. Yet, her life takes a turn after she meets Antonio Vivaldi, a brilliant and ambitious composer who becomes the new violin teacher. Guided by Vivaldi and his music, Cecilia finds the strength to challenge the destiny that once seemed inevitable.
synopsis_en: A drama based on the true story of composer Vivaldi's appointment as a violin teacher at the Ospedale della Pietà in Venice in the early 18th century, depicting the growth of a lonely girl whose talent blossoms under his guidance, and Vivaldi's inner ambition, craving recognition for his own genius. Venice, 1716, at the Ospedale della Pietà. Cecilia, raised without knowing her mother's presence or love, secretly slips out of bed every night to write letters to her mother with no address. To leave the Pietà and live in the outside world, her mother must come for her, or she must marry a nobleman. Amidst this, Antonio Vivaldi, arriving as a violin teacher, discovers Cecilia's exceptional violin skill and appoints her as the leader of the first violins. Under Vivaldi, Cecilia endures rigorous practice, hones her violin skills, and they gradually grow close. However, the officer the Pietà has chosen as Cecilia's husband returns from war, and an incident soon occurs. Tekla Insolia, noted for the Italian TV drama 'The Art of Joy,' plays Cecilia, and Michele Riondino of 'The Sleeping Beauty' plays Vivaldi. The film is directed and written by Damiano Michieletto, a leading Italian opera director who served as creative director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics.

synopsis: かいせつ 旧華族の一人娘の雪は、婿養子の夫の放蕩と横暴に苦しめられ…。戦前から在籍した松竹を離れた溝口が新東宝で撮った官能のメロドラマ。雪夫人を演じた木暮の目も眩む濃密なエロスが、溝口独特の耽美的な世界へと誘い込む。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman takes up her new job as the servant of a noblewoman and soon discovers that underneath her facade of luxury lies great unhappiness.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.

synopsis: かいせつ 貴族に代わり武士が台頭した平安末期、平清盛は様々な苦難に直面し…。出生の秘密に悩む“人間”清盛を、溝口が圧倒的なスケールで描く歴史劇。デビュー間もない雷蔵が若き清盛を颯爽と演じ、濃艶な母親役の木暮も忘れ難い。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 日本、1137年。鳥羽天皇と比叡山の僧との争いに巻き込まれた武士、平氏。
tmdb_overview_en: Japan, 1137. The Taira family, a samurai clan, becomes involved in the disputes between Emperor Toba and the monks of Mount Hiei.
synopsis_en: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.

synopsis: かいせつ 妹の縁談相手の男は、見合いに同席した姉に惹かれ…。数々の傑作を生み出し黄金期となる大映での溝口の第一作。名キャメラマン・宮川とも初めて組み、美しい姉妹と一人の男の揺れ動く三角関係を繊細で夢幻的な映像美で描く。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Shinnosuke is introduced to Shizu as a prospective marriage partner, but he falls in love with her widowed sister Oyu. Convention forbids Oyu to marry because she has to raise her son as the head of her husband's family. Oyu convinces Shinnosuke and Shizu to marry so that she can remain close to Shinnosuke.
synopsis_en: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.

synopsis: かいせつ 最愛の妃を亡くした唐の玄宗皇帝が、一人の娘を見初めて…。香港との共同制作となった溝口初のカラー作品は、傾国の美女・楊貴妃の愛と悲運を描いた宮廷絵巻。エキゾチックな衣装と美術を際立たせる抑えた色調が目をひく。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In 8th-century China, the Emperor grieves the death of his wife. The Yang family wants to provide the Emperor with a consort so that they may consolidate their court influence. General An Lushan finds a distant relative working in their kitchen, whom they groom to present to the Emperor. The Emperor falls in love and she becomes the Princess Yang Kwei-fei. The Yangs are then appointed important ministers, though An Lushan is not given the court position he covets.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1970 年代、ユマ郡の砂漠地帯。最後の給油所であるダイナーの戸をセールスマンが叩いた。定刻になっても給油車が来ないのだ。セールスマンはウェイトレスと話しながら時間を潰す。 そこに現れたのは、凶悪な銀行強盗。  セールスマンとウェイトレスは人質となってしまう。だがガソリンがないので銀行強盗もダイナーから出られない。そんな状況も知らずに次々とクセありの面々がダイナーを訪れる。老夫婦、インディアンのチーフ、頼りない保安官、そして犯罪者を目指すカップル…。はたしてセールスマンとウェイトレスは無事に生還できるのか！？
tmdb_overview_en: While awaiting the next fuel truck at a middle-of-nowhere Arizona rest stop, a traveling young knife salesman is thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two similarly stranded bank robbers with no qualms about using cruelty—or cold, hard steel—to protect their bloodstained, ill-gotten fortune.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1716 年、ヴェネツィアのピエタ院。赤ちゃんポストに置き去りにされたチェチリア（テクラ・インソリア）は、母の姿も愛情も知らずにこの院で育ち、毎晩こっそりベッドから抜け出してはろうそくの灯りで、宛名のない母への手紙を綴っていた。院から出て外の世界で暮らすには、母親が迎えに来るか、貴族に見いだされ結婚するかしかなかった。そんな中、ピエタ院にアントニオ・ヴィヴァルディ（ミケーレ・リオンディーノ）がヴァイオリン教師として赴任すると、卓越したヴァイオリンの技術を持つチェチリアを見出し、第一ヴァイオリンのリーダーに任命する。ヴィヴァルディからの厳しい練習に耐え、ヴァイオリンの腕があがっていくチェチリア。いつしか二人は心を通わせるようになる。そんな折、ピエタ院が決めたチェチリアの結婚相手である将校がトルコとの戦争から戻り、結婚が迫ったある日、事件が起こる……。
tmdb_overview_en: In 18th-century Venice, 20-year-old violin virtuoso Cecilia lives at the Pièta orphanage, where, despite her talent, she remains confined, knowing that marriage is the only way out. Yet, her life takes a turn after she meets Antonio Vivaldi, a brilliant and ambitious composer who becomes the new violin teacher. Guided by Vivaldi and his music, Cecilia finds the strength to challenge the destiny that once seemed inevitable.
synopsis_en: A drama based on the true story of composer Vivaldi's appointment as a violin teacher at the Ospedale della Pietà in Venice in the early 18th century, depicting the growth of a lonely girl whose talent blossoms under his guidance, and Vivaldi's inner ambition, craving recognition for his own genius. Venice, 1716, at the Ospedale della Pietà. Cecilia, raised without knowing her mother's presence or love, secretly slips out of bed every night to write letters to her mother with no address. To leave the Pietà and live in the outside world, her mother must come for her, or she must marry a nobleman. Amidst this, Antonio Vivaldi, arriving as a violin teacher, discovers Cecilia's exceptional violin skill and appoints her as the leader of the first violins. Under Vivaldi, Cecilia endures rigorous practice, hones her violin skills, and they gradually grow close. However, the officer the Pietà has chosen as Cecilia's husband returns from war, and an incident soon occurs. Tekla Insolia, noted for the Italian TV drama 'The Art of Joy,' plays Cecilia, and Michele Riondino of 'The Sleeping Beauty' plays Vivaldi. The film is directed and written by Damiano Michieletto, a leading Italian opera director who served as creative director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1970 年代、ユマ郡の砂漠地帯。最後の給油所であるダイナーの戸をセールスマンが叩いた。定刻になっても給油車が来ないのだ。セールスマンはウェイトレスと話しながら時間を潰す。 そこに現れたのは、凶悪な銀行強盗。  セールスマンとウェイトレスは人質となってしまう。だがガソリンがないので銀行強盗もダイナーから出られない。そんな状況も知らずに次々とクセありの面々がダイナーを訪れる。老夫婦、インディアンのチーフ、頼りない保安官、そして犯罪者を目指すカップル…。はたしてセールスマンとウェイトレスは無事に生還できるのか！？
tmdb_overview_en: While awaiting the next fuel truck at a middle-of-nowhere Arizona rest stop, a traveling young knife salesman is thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two similarly stranded bank robbers with no qualms about using cruelty—or cold, hard steel—to protect their bloodstained, ill-gotten fortune.

synopsis_en: The feature-length debut of up-and-coming director Francis Galluppi, this black comedy crime thriller depicts a series of unpredictable worst-case scenarios unfolding at a desert diner. In the 1970s, in the desert region of Yuma County, Arizona. A salesman visits a diner that serves as the last gas station. When the fuel truck doesn't arrive on time, the salesman passes the time chatting with a waitress. A vicious bank robber shows up, taking the salesman and waitress hostage. However, because there's no gasoline, the bank robber can't leave the diner either. Unaware of the situation, a steady stream of quirky customers arrives at the diner: an elderly couple, an Indian chief, a hapless sheriff, and a couple aspiring to be criminals. Jim Cummings of "The Thunder Road" plays the salesman, Jocelin Donahue of "The House of the Devil" plays the waitress, and Richard Brake of "Barbarian" plays the bank robber. The film won the Best Picture award in the ORBITA section at the 2023 Sitges International Film Festival, which selects the best thrillers, suspense, and action films, earning high praise.

tmdb_overview_en: A group of men and women have been brought together after World War II, when Italy regained its national and territorial unity. They make up a primitive community which seeks to erase not only the distress created by the war but also the hardships of life, and look to protect themselves from violence, misery and fear. Amid the ruins of this post-war period, these men and women build a new rapport between themselves, between sexes, between generations, between social and geographical origins, between political camps.

synopsis: かいせつ 最愛の妃を亡くした唐の玄宗皇帝が、一人の娘を見初めて…。香港との共同制作となった溝口初のカラー作品は、傾国の美女・楊貴妃の愛と悲運を描いた宮廷絵巻。エキゾチックな衣装と美術を際立たせる抑えた色調が目をひく。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In 8th-century China, the Emperor grieves the death of his wife. The Yang family wants to provide the Emperor with a consort so that they may consolidate their court influence. General An Lushan finds a distant relative working in their kitchen, whom they groom to present to the Emperor. The Emperor falls in love and she becomes the Princess Yang Kwei-fei. The Yangs are then appointed important ministers, though An Lushan is not given the court position he covets.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.

synopsis: かいせつ 旧華族の一人娘の雪は、婿養子の夫の放蕩と横暴に苦しめられ…。戦前から在籍した松竹を離れた溝口が新東宝で撮った官能のメロドラマ。雪夫人を演じた木暮の目も眩む濃密なエロスが、溝口独特の耽美的な世界へと誘い込む。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman takes up her new job as the servant of a noblewoman and soon discovers that underneath her facade of luxury lies great unhappiness.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.

synopsis: かいせつ 妹の縁談相手の男は、見合いに同席した姉に惹かれ…。数々の傑作を生み出し黄金期となる大映での溝口の第一作。名キャメラマン・宮川とも初めて組み、美しい姉妹と一人の男の揺れ動く三角関係を繊細で夢幻的な映像美で描く。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Shinnosuke is introduced to Shizu as a prospective marriage partner, but he falls in love with her widowed sister Oyu. Convention forbids Oyu to marry because she has to raise her son as the head of her husband's family. Oyu convinces Shinnosuke and Shizu to marry so that she can remain close to Shinnosuke.
synopsis_en: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.

cinema_name: アテネ・フランセ文化センター
tmdb_overview_en: Nine fictitious documentaries and films reflect the mood of late 1970s Germany, particularly the two-month period in 1977 when a businessman was kidnapped by the RAF (Red Army Faction). The kidnap had been made to orchestrate the release of the original leaders of the RAF, aka the Baader-Meinhof.

cinema_name: アテネ・フランセ文化センター
tmdb_overview_en: A famous poet in postwar Paris, scorned by the Left Bank youth, is in love with both his wife Eurydice and a mysterious princess. Seeking inspiration, the poet becomes obsessed and follows the princess from the world of the living to the land of the dead.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1716 年、ヴェネツィアのピエタ院。赤ちゃんポストに置き去りにされたチェチリア（テクラ・インソリア）は、母の姿も愛情も知らずにこの院で育ち、毎晩こっそりベッドから抜け出してはろうそくの灯りで、宛名のない母への手紙を綴っていた。院から出て外の世界で暮らすには、母親が迎えに来るか、貴族に見いだされ結婚するかしかなかった。そんな中、ピエタ院にアントニオ・ヴィヴァルディ（ミケーレ・リオンディーノ）がヴァイオリン教師として赴任すると、卓越したヴァイオリンの技術を持つチェチリアを見出し、第一ヴァイオリンのリーダーに任命する。ヴィヴァルディからの厳しい練習に耐え、ヴァイオリンの腕があがっていくチェチリア。いつしか二人は心を通わせるようになる。そんな折、ピエタ院が決めたチェチリアの結婚相手である将校がトルコとの戦争から戻り、結婚が迫ったある日、事件が起こる……。
tmdb_overview_en: In 18th-century Venice, 20-year-old violin virtuoso Cecilia lives at the Pièta orphanage, where, despite her talent, she remains confined, knowing that marriage is the only way out. Yet, her life takes a turn after she meets Antonio Vivaldi, a brilliant and ambitious composer who becomes the new violin teacher. Guided by Vivaldi and his music, Cecilia finds the strength to challenge the destiny that once seemed inevitable.
synopsis_en: A drama based on the true story of composer Vivaldi's appointment as a violin teacher at the Ospedale della Pietà in Venice in the early 18th century, depicting the growth of a lonely girl whose talent blossoms under his guidance, and Vivaldi's inner ambition, craving recognition for his own genius. Venice, 1716, at the Ospedale della Pietà. Cecilia, raised without knowing her mother's presence or love, secretly slips out of bed every night to write letters to her mother with no address. To leave the Pietà and live in the outside world, her mother must come for her, or she must marry a nobleman. Amidst this, Antonio Vivaldi, arriving as a violin teacher, discovers Cecilia's exceptional violin skill and appoints her as the leader of the first violins. Under Vivaldi, Cecilia endures rigorous practice, hones her violin skills, and they gradually grow close. However, the officer the Pietà has chosen as Cecilia's husband returns from war, and an incident soon occurs. Tekla Insolia, noted for the Italian TV drama 'The Art of Joy,' plays Cecilia, and Michele Riondino of 'The Sleeping Beauty' plays Vivaldi. The film is directed and written by Damiano Michieletto, a leading Italian opera director who served as creative director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1970 年代、ユマ郡の砂漠地帯。最後の給油所であるダイナーの戸をセールスマンが叩いた。定刻になっても給油車が来ないのだ。セールスマンはウェイトレスと話しながら時間を潰す。 そこに現れたのは、凶悪な銀行強盗。  セールスマンとウェイトレスは人質となってしまう。だがガソリンがないので銀行強盗もダイナーから出られない。そんな状況も知らずに次々とクセありの面々がダイナーを訪れる。老夫婦、インディアンのチーフ、頼りない保安官、そして犯罪者を目指すカップル…。はたしてセールスマンとウェイトレスは無事に生還できるのか！？
tmdb_overview_en: While awaiting the next fuel truck at a middle-of-nowhere Arizona rest stop, a traveling young knife salesman is thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two similarly stranded bank robbers with no qualms about using cruelty—or cold, hard steel—to protect their bloodstained, ill-gotten fortune.

movie_title_original: The Last Stop in Yuma County
movie_title_en: The Last Stop in Yuma County
synopsis_en: The feature-length debut of up-and-coming director Francis Galluppi, this black comedy crime thriller depicts a series of unpredictable worst-case scenarios unfolding at a desert diner. In the 1970s, in the desert region of Yuma County, Arizona. A salesman visits a diner that serves as the last gas station. When the fuel truck doesn't arrive on time, the salesman passes the time chatting with a waitress. A vicious bank robber shows up, taking the salesman and waitress hostage. However, because there's no gasoline, the bank robber can't leave the diner either. Unaware of the situation, a steady stream of quirky customers arrives at the diner: an elderly couple, an Indian chief, a hapless sheriff, and a couple aspiring to be criminals. Jim Cummings of "The Thunder Road" plays the salesman, Jocelin Donahue of "The House of the Devil" plays the waitress, and Richard Brake of "Barbarian" plays the bank robber. The film won the Best Picture award in the ORBITA section at the 2023 Sitges International Film Festival, which selects the best thrillers, suspense, and action films, earning high praise.

tmdb_overview_en: Roberto is one of those men to whom simulation has become the greatest art. He is an unmoved, inscrutable, mysterious man. But the truth is that Robert feels an intimate, deep tedium. The boredom of those who have already exhausted all the pleasures of life. The only thing still surprising him is the fact that nothing surprises him anymore. One evening he has an overwhelming encounter with a woman. For his own bewilderment, he discovers the sublime horrors in which the woman has sank.

synopsis: かいせつ 妹の縁談相手の男は、見合いに同席した姉に惹かれ…。数々の傑作を生み出し黄金期となる大映での溝口の第一作。名キャメラマン・宮川とも初めて組み、美しい姉妹と一人の男の揺れ動く三角関係を繊細で夢幻的な映像美で描く。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Shinnosuke is introduced to Shizu as a prospective marriage partner, but he falls in love with her widowed sister Oyu. Convention forbids Oyu to marry because she has to raise her son as the head of her husband's family. Oyu convinces Shinnosuke and Shizu to marry so that she can remain close to Shinnosuke.
synopsis_en: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.

synopsis: かいせつ 最愛の妃を亡くした唐の玄宗皇帝が、一人の娘を見初めて…。香港との共同制作となった溝口初のカラー作品は、傾国の美女・楊貴妃の愛と悲運を描いた宮廷絵巻。エキゾチックな衣装と美術を際立たせる抑えた色調が目をひく。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In 8th-century China, the Emperor grieves the death of his wife. The Yang family wants to provide the Emperor with a consort so that they may consolidate their court influence. General An Lushan finds a distant relative working in their kitchen, whom they groom to present to the Emperor. The Emperor falls in love and she becomes the Princess Yang Kwei-fei. The Yangs are then appointed important ministers, though An Lushan is not given the court position he covets.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.

synopsis: かいせつ 旧華族の一人娘の雪は、婿養子の夫の放蕩と横暴に苦しめられ…。戦前から在籍した松竹を離れた溝口が新東宝で撮った官能のメロドラマ。雪夫人を演じた木暮の目も眩む濃密なエロスが、溝口独特の耽美的な世界へと誘い込む。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman takes up her new job as the servant of a noblewoman and soon discovers that underneath her facade of luxury lies great unhappiness.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.

tmdb_overview_jp: マダム・リリーの娼館では、退廃的な紫煙の中で命がけの賭博が行なわれている。客たちは少女の娼婦や美少年を相手にその場に酔っている。この娼館で評判の歌姫ヴィオラ、またの名を“ラ・パロマ”（イングリッド・カーフェン）が“シャンハイ”を歌いながら舞台に現われる。その艶姿をじっと見つめている男の客がいた。名前をイジドール（ペーター・カーン）というその男は、連日ラ・パロマの楽屋に黄色いバラを持って訪ねるが、酒びたりの彼女に激しく拒絶される。
tmdb_overview_en: Nightclub singer La Paloma succumbs to the persistent courting of a chubby, rich admirer and marries him. Before the marriage, she was thought to be dying, but soon she is well. She believes her husband's love has cured her, but her efforts to love him begin to fade as she discovers true love with her husband's old school friend.
synopsis_en: At Madame Lily's brothel, life-or-death gambling takes place amidst decadent plumes of purple smoke. The patrons are intoxicated by the company of young prostitutes and beautiful boys. The brothel's celebrated chanteuse, Viola—also known as "La Paloma" (Ingrid Caven)—appears on stage singing "Shanghai." A male patron gazes intently at her alluring figure. This man, named Isidore (Peter Kern), visits La Paloma's dressing room day after day with a yellow rose, but is fiercely rejected by her, drowned in alcohol.

program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界

program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 赤線地帯にある特殊飲食店「夢の里」の主人は、国会に上程されている売春禁止法案が可決されたら売春婦はみな投獄されると、女たちを慌てさせる。より江はなじみ客と結婚するが、夫婦生活が破綻し舞い戻ってきた。一人息子のために働くゆめ子だったが、その息子から縁を切られ発狂してしまった。やすみは自分に貢いでくれた客に殺されかけた。ラジオが売春禁止法案の否決を伝えると、「夢の里」は再び客の呼び込みを始めた。そしてそこには、店を辞めたやすみに代わり、下働きだったしず子の姿があった。
tmdb_overview_en: Follows five sex workers employed at a Japanese brothel while the nation debates the passage of an anti-prostitution law.
synopsis_en: Commentary: Mizoguchi Kenji's final work. Set in a Yoshiwara brothel in Tokyo on the eve of the abolition of the red-light district, this female ensemble piece depicts the joys and sorrows of women who have drifted there with various circumstances. The nonchalant prostitutes, played by a cast of luxurious actresses, exude a peculiar atmosphere, making this film a one-of-a-kind red-light district story.

tmdb_overview_jp: 赤線地帯にある特殊飲食店「夢の里」の主人は、国会に上程されている売春禁止法案が可決されたら売春婦はみな投獄されると、女たちを慌てさせる。より江はなじみ客と結婚するが、夫婦生活が破綻し舞い戻ってきた。一人息子のために働くゆめ子だったが、その息子から縁を切られ発狂してしまった。やすみは自分に貢いでくれた客に殺されかけた。ラジオが売春禁止法案の否決を伝えると、「夢の里」は再び客の呼び込みを始めた。そしてそこには、店を辞めたやすみに代わり、下働きだったしず子の姿があった。
tmdb_overview_en: Follows five sex workers employed at a Japanese brothel while the nation debates the passage of an anti-prostitution law.
synopsis_en: Commentary: Mizoguchi Kenji's final work. Set in a Yoshiwara brothel in Tokyo on the eve of the abolition of the red-light district, this female ensemble piece depicts the joys and sorrows of women who have drifted there with various circumstances. The nonchalant prostitutes, played by a cast of luxurious actresses, exude a peculiar atmosphere, making this film a one-of-a-kind red-light district story.

synopsis: かいせつ 京都・祇園の花街で生きる対照的な芸妓姉妹を透徹した眼差しで描いた傑作。古風で情に流され易い姉と現代的でドライな妹は…。従順な姉に反発し男を手玉に取ろうとする妹を演じた、当時19歳の山田の貫禄から目が離せない。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A geisha in the Gion district of Kyoto feels obliged to help her lover when he asks to stay with her after going bankrupt and leaving his wife. However, her younger sister opposes this, thinking that they should both find wealthy patrons to support them.
synopsis_en: A commentary: A masterpiece that gazes with a penetrating eye at two contrasting geisha sisters living in Kyoto's Gion pleasure district. The older sister, old-fashioned and easily swayed by emotion, and the younger sister, modern and pragmatic... You can't take your eyes off the 19-year-old Yamada, who plays the younger sister rebelling against her submissive elder sibling and trying to toy with men, exuding a remarkable presence.

movie_title: 『殘菊物語』 《デジタル修復版》 ＊デジタル上映
movie_title_en: The Story of the Last Chrysanthemum
synopsis: かいせつ 周囲から見放された歌舞伎の御曹司・菊之助は、弟の乳母・お徳の献身的な愛に支えられ茨の芸の道を歩むが―。芸道物の金字塔の一本にして、長回し撮影を多用した緊張感漲る画面の連続から溝口の神髄に触れられる奇跡の傑作。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In late 19th-century Tokyo, Kikunosuke Onoue, the adopted son of a legendary actor, himself an actor specializing in female roles, discovers that the praise he receives is only due to his status as his father's heir. Devastated, he turns to Otoku, a servant of his family, for comfort, and they fall in love. Kikunosuke becomes determined to leave home and develop as an actor on his own merits, and Otoku faithfully joins him.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Kikunosuke, the son of a kabuki family abandoned by those around him, walks a thorny path of artistic dedication, supported by the devoted love of O-Toku, his younger brother's wet nurse... This is a pinnacle of the artistic path genre and a miraculous masterpiece that allows one to touch the essence of Mizoguchi through a succession of tension-filled shots, making heavy use of long takes.

synopsis: かいせつ 偶然から手代・茂兵衛との不義密通を疑われた京都の大経師の若妻・おさんは―。近松の浄瑠璃を基に、命懸けの逃避行から真実の愛に目覚める男女を厳密かつ流麗な筆致で描いた名篇。おさん役の香川の気丈な美しさは見逃せない。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: When the wife of a 17th-century Kyoto scrollmaker is falsely accused of having an affair with his best employee, the pair flee the city and find themselves truly falling for one another.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Osan, the young wife of a Kyoto paper merchant, is suspected of adultery with the clerk Mohei due to a chance incident... Based on a Chikamatsu puppet play, this celebrated film depicts a man and woman who awaken to true love through a life-or-death escape, rendered with rigorous yet flowing brushstrokes. The dignified beauty of Kagawa as Osan is not to be missed.

synopsis: かいせつ 古寺の山門に立つ老街娼(田中)は、自らの流転の人生を回想していた…。家筋も良く御所勤めの経験もある娘が、いかにして身を落としたのか―。溝口・田中コンビの最高傑作との呼び声も高く、ヴェネチア映画祭で国際賞を受賞した。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 奈良の荒れ寺に集まる街娼たち。年老いたお春は羅漢堂に入り、過去に出会った男の面影を思い浮かべていた。御所勤めをしていた13歳のお春は、公卿の勝之介に宿に連れ込まれたところを見つかり、両親ともども洛外へ追放となってしまった。その後、松平家に取り立てられ嗣子をもうけたものの、側近の裏切りに遭い実家へ帰されてしまう。島原の郭に売られたお春は、気に入られた客の住み込み女中となるが、その妻に嫉妬され追い出されてしまった。さらに結婚相手が急死し、世話になった男の盗みが発覚して捕らえられるなど、流転の人生を歩むのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: During the Edo Period, a noblewoman's banishment for her love affair with a lowly page signals the beginning of her inexorable fall.
synopsis_en: Commentary: An old street prostitute (Tanaka) standing at the gate of an ancient temple recalls her tumultuous life... How did a girl from a good family with experience serving at the imperial court fall so low? Hailed as the greatest masterpiece of the Mizoguchi-Tanaka partnership, it won an international award at the Venice Film Festival.

synopsis: かいせつ 戦乱の世、欲望に駆られた男たちは、女たちを犠牲にしてまで幻影を追い求め…。怪異譚の古典を原作に、欲に惑う人間の愚かさを、現実と幻想の間に映し出す名作。ヴェネチア映画祭銀獅子賞に輝き、溝口の名を世界に轟かせた。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 戦国の世、貧しい陶工・源十郎が若狭姫という女性と知り合い、生活をともにするようになる。だが美しい若狭姫の正体は死霊であった。それを知った源十郎は若狭姫を捨てて故郷に逃げるが、彼女の怨念は執拗に追いすがる……。「雨月物語」をベースに、川口松太郎らが脚色。
tmdb_overview_en: In 16th century Japan, peasants Genjuro and Tobei sell their earthenware pots to a group of soldiers in a nearby village, in defiance of a local sage's warning against seeking to profit from warfare. Genjuro's pursuit of both riches and the mysterious Lady Wakasa, as well as Tobei's desire to become a samurai, run the risk of destroying both themselves and their wives, Miyagi and Ohama.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In an age of war, men driven by lust chase illusions even at the cost of sacrificing women... Based on a classic tale of the supernatural, this masterpiece reflects the folly of humans deluded by desire, suspended between reality and fantasy. Winner of the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, it spread Mizoguchi's name worldwide.

synopsis: かいせつ 平安時代、親と引き離された厨子王と安寿は、奴隷として売られてしまう―。中世の説話をもとにした鷗外の短編の映画化で、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞に輝いた不朽の名作。名キャメラマン・宮川がとらえた映像美にも感服。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 森鴎外の同名小説を、八尋不二と依田義賢が共同で脚色し、溝口健二がメガホンをとった文芸作品。特に美術と撮影はレベルが高く、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞を受賞した。美しいラストシーンは、ゴダールが「気狂いピエロ」において引用したことでも知られる。 　平安時代末期、農民を救うため将軍にたてついた平正氏が左遷された。妻の玉木、娘の安寿と息子の厨子王は越後を旅している途中、人買いにだまされ離ればなれになってしまう。玉木は佐渡に、安寿と厨子王は丹後の山椒大夫に奴隷として売られた。きょうだいはそれから十年もの間、奴隷としての生活を続けるが、ついに意を決して逃げ出すことにする。しかし追っ手に迫られ、安寿は厨子王を逃すため池に身を投げるのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: In 11th-century feudal Japan, following the exile of an idealistic governor, his wife and children are separated by slave traders; the children, Zushio and Anju, are sold into brutal servitude under the cruel bailiff Sansho.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In the Heian period, Zushio and Anju, separated from their parents, are sold into slavery... A film adaptation of Ogai's short story based on a medieval folktale, this timeless masterpiece won the Silver Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. The visual beauty captured by the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa is also awe-inspiring.

Set in a Yoshiwara brothel in Tokyo on the eve of the abolition of the red-light district, this female ensemble piece depicts the joys and sorrows of women who have drifted there with various circumstances. The nonchalant prostitutes, played by a cast of luxurious actresses, exude a peculiar atmosphere, making this film a one-of-a-kind red-light district story.

synopsis: かいせつ 古寺の山門に立つ老街娼(田中)は、自らの流転の人生を回想していた…。家筋も良く御所勤めの経験もある娘が、いかにして身を落としたのか―。溝口・田中コンビの最高傑作との呼び声も高く、ヴェネチア映画祭で国際賞を受賞した。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 奈良の荒れ寺に集まる街娼たち。年老いたお春は羅漢堂に入り、過去に出会った男の面影を思い浮かべていた。御所勤めをしていた13歳のお春は、公卿の勝之介に宿に連れ込まれたところを見つかり、両親ともども洛外へ追放となってしまった。その後、松平家に取り立てられ嗣子をもうけたものの、側近の裏切りに遭い実家へ帰されてしまう。島原の郭に売られたお春は、気に入られた客の住み込み女中となるが、その妻に嫉妬され追い出されてしまった。さらに結婚相手が急死し、世話になった男の盗みが発覚して捕らえられるなど、流転の人生を歩むのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: During the Edo Period, a noblewoman's banishment for her love affair with a lowly page signals the beginning of her inexorable fall.
synopsis_en: Commentary: An old street prostitute (Tanaka) standing at the gate of an ancient temple recalls her tumultuous life... How did a girl from a good family with experience serving at the imperial court fall so low? Hailed as the greatest masterpiece of the Mizoguchi-Tanaka partnership, it won an international award at the Venice Film Festival.

synopsis: かいせつ 戦乱の世、欲望に駆られた男たちは、女たちを犠牲にしてまで幻影を追い求め…。怪異譚の古典を原作に、欲に惑う人間の愚かさを、現実と幻想の間に映し出す名作。ヴェネチア映画祭銀獅子賞に輝き、溝口の名を世界に轟かせた。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 戦国の世、貧しい陶工・源十郎が若狭姫という女性と知り合い、生活をともにするようになる。だが美しい若狭姫の正体は死霊であった。それを知った源十郎は若狭姫を捨てて故郷に逃げるが、彼女の怨念は執拗に追いすがる……。「雨月物語」をベースに、川口松太郎らが脚色。
tmdb_overview_en: In 16th century Japan, peasants Genjuro and Tobei sell their earthenware pots to a group of soldiers in a nearby village, in defiance of a local sage's warning against seeking to profit from warfare. Genjuro's pursuit of both riches and the mysterious Lady Wakasa, as well as Tobei's desire to become a samurai, run the risk of destroying both themselves and their wives, Miyagi and Ohama.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In an age of war, men driven by lust chase illusions even at the cost of sacrificing women... Based on a classic tale of the supernatural, this masterpiece reflects the folly of humans deluded by desire, suspended between reality and fantasy. Winner of the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, it spread Mizoguchi's name worldwide.

synopsis: かいせつ 平安時代、親と引き離された厨子王と安寿は、奴隷として売られてしまう―。中世の説話をもとにした鷗外の短編の映画化で、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞に輝いた不朽の名作。名キャメラマン・宮川がとらえた映像美にも感服。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 森鴎外の同名小説を、八尋不二と依田義賢が共同で脚色し、溝口健二がメガホンをとった文芸作品。特に美術と撮影はレベルが高く、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞を受賞した。美しいラストシーンは、ゴダールが「気狂いピエロ」において引用したことでも知られる。 　平安時代末期、農民を救うため将軍にたてついた平正氏が左遷された。妻の玉木、娘の安寿と息子の厨子王は越後を旅している途中、人買いにだまされ離ればなれになってしまう。玉木は佐渡に、安寿と厨子王は丹後の山椒大夫に奴隷として売られた。きょうだいはそれから十年もの間、奴隷としての生活を続けるが、ついに意を決して逃げ出すことにする。しかし追っ手に迫られ、安寿は厨子王を逃すため池に身を投げるのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: In 11th-century feudal Japan, following the exile of an idealistic governor, his wife and children are separated by slave traders; the children, Zushio and Anju, are sold into brutal servitude under the cruel bailiff Sansho.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In the Heian period, Zushio and Anju, separated from their parents, are sold into slavery... A film adaptation of Ogai's short story based on a medieval folktale, this timeless masterpiece won the Silver Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. The visual beauty captured by the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa is also awe-inspiring.

synopsis: かいせつ 溝口健二の遺作。赤線廃止前夜の東京・吉原の娼館を舞台に、様々な事情を抱えて流れ着いた女たちの哀歓を描いた女性群像。豪華女優陣が演じる飄々とした娼婦たちは妙な雰囲気を醸し出し、本作を唯一無二の赤線ものにしている。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 赤線地帯にある特殊飲食店「夢の里」の主人は、国会に上程されている売春禁止法案が可決されたら売春婦はみな投獄されると、女たちを慌てさせる。より江はなじみ客と結婚するが、夫婦生活が破綻し舞い戻ってきた。一人息子のために働くゆめ子だったが、その息子から縁を切られ発狂してしまった。やすみは自分に貢いでくれた客に殺されかけた。ラジオが売春禁止法案の否決を伝えると、「夢の里」は再び客の呼び込みを始めた。そしてそこには、店を辞めたやすみに代わり、下働きだったしず子の姿があった。

tmdb_overview_jp: 戦国の世、貧しい陶工・源十郎が若狭姫という女性と知り合い、生活をともにするようになる。だが美しい若狭姫の正体は死霊であった。それを知った源十郎は若狭姫を捨てて故郷に逃げるが、彼女の怨念は執拗に追いすがる……。「雨月物語」をベースに、川口松太郎らが脚色。
tmdb_overview_en: In 16th century Japan, peasants Genjuro and Tobei sell their earthenware pots to a group of soldiers in a nearby village, in defiance of a local sage's warning against seeking to profit from warfare. Genjuro's pursuit of both riches and the mysterious Lady Wakasa, as well as Tobei's desire to become a samurai, run the risk of destroying both themselves and their wives, Miyagi and Ohama.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In an age of war, men driven by lust chase illusions even at the cost of sacrificing women... Based on a classic tale of the supernatural, this masterpiece reflects the folly of humans deluded by desire, suspended between reality and fantasy. Winner of the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, it spread Mizoguchi's name worldwide.

synopsis: かいせつ 平安時代、親と引き離された厨子王と安寿は、奴隷として売られてしまう―。中世の説話をもとにした鷗外の短編の映画化で、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞に輝いた不朽の名作。名キャメラマン・宮川がとらえた映像美にも感服。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 森鴎外の同名小説を、八尋不二と依田義賢が共同で脚色し、溝口健二がメガホンをとった文芸作品。特に美術と撮影はレベルが高く、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞を受賞した。美しいラストシーンは、ゴダールが「気狂いピエロ」において引用したことでも知られる。 　平安時代末期、農民を救うため将軍にたてついた平正氏が左遷された。妻の玉木、娘の安寿と息子の厨子王は越後を旅している途中、人買いにだまされ離ればなれになってしまう。玉木は佐渡に、安寿と厨子王は丹後の山椒大夫に奴隷として売られた。きょうだいはそれから十年もの間、奴隷としての生活を続けるが、ついに意を決して逃げ出すことにする。しかし追っ手に迫られ、安寿は厨子王を逃すため池に身を投げるのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: In 11th-century feudal Japan, following the exile of an idealistic governor, his wife and children are separated by slave traders; the children, Zushio and Anju, are sold into brutal servitude under the cruel bailiff Sansho.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In the Heian period, Zushio and Anju, separated from their parents, are sold into slavery... A film adaptation of Ogai's short story based on a medieval folktale, this timeless masterpiece won the Silver Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. The visual beauty captured by the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa is also awe-inspiring.
